Calculator.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes an object's arithmetic operator mapping by storing a dictionary that associates '+', '-', '*', '/', and '^' with lambda functions for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and exponentiation." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign to self.operators a literal dictionary with the keys '+', '-', '*', '/', and '^'; map each key to a lambda function taking x and y: addition returns x + y, subtraction returns x - y, multiplication returns x * y, division returns x / y, and exponentiation returns x ** y. RESULT self.operators]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Calculator.calculate:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Evaluates an infix arithmetic expression using the shunting-yard algorithm with explicit operator-precedence handling and returns the numeric result, or None if no operands are present." calculate]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> expression </REF>: string "Infix arithmetic expression to evaluate; digits and '.' build numbers, supported operators are +, -, *, /, ^, and parentheses are handled as grouping symbols."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: float or None "The evaluated numeric result, or None when the expression contains no complete operand."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize operand_stack as an empty list, operator_stack as an empty list, and num_buffer as an empty string. RESULT _init_state]
            [COMMAND Start iterating over each character char in expression with the outer for loop. RESULT _loop_start]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop, if char is a digit or '.', append char to num_buffer. RESULT _num_buffer]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop, when char is not a digit or '.', first check if num_buffer is truthy; if so, convert float(num_buffer), append it to operand_stack, and reset num_buffer to an empty string. RESULT _flushed_number]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop, after flushing any pending number, if char is one of '+', '-', '*', '/', '^', then while operator_stack is non-empty and its top element is not '(' and self.precedence(operator_stack[-1]) >= self.precedence(char), assign operand_stack and operator_stack from the result of self.apply_operator(operand_stack, operator_stack). RESULT _reduced_operators]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop, after the precedence-reducing while loop for an operator char, append char to operator_stack. RESULT _pushed_operator]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop, if char is '(', append '(' to operator_stack. RESULT _pushed_left_paren]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop, if char is ')', while operator_stack is non-empty and its top element is not '(', assign operand_stack and operator_stack from the result of self.apply_operator(operand_stack, operator_stack); then pop the '(' from operator_stack. RESULT _resolved_right_paren]
            [COMMAND Within the outer for loop, if char is not a digit, '.', operator, '(' or ')', ignore it after the pending-number flush has been performed. RESULT _ignored_char]
            [COMMAND After the outer for loop completes, if num_buffer is truthy, convert float(num_buffer), append it to operand_stack, and reset num_buffer to an empty string. RESULT _final_number_flush]
            [COMMAND After the final number flush, while operator_stack is non-empty, assign operand_stack and operator_stack from the result of self.apply_operator(operand_stack, operator_stack). RESULT _drained_operators]
            [COMMAND If operand_stack is non-empty, return operand_stack[-1]; otherwise return None. RESULT _return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Calculator.precedence:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the precedence level for a given arithmetic operator, defaulting to 0 when the operator is not recognized." precedence]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> operator </REF>: string "The operator symbol whose precedence level is requested."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: integer "The precedence level: 1 for '+' or '-', 2 for '*' or '/', 3 for '^', or 0 for an unknown operator."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a precedences dictionary mapping '+' and '-' to 1, '*' and '/' to 2, and '^' to 3. RESULT precedences]
            [COMMAND Look up operator in the precedences dictionary and return the mapped precedence. RESULT precedence_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If operator is not present as a key in the precedences dictionary]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the default precedence value 0. RESULT precedence_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Calculator.apply_operator:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Pops the top operator from operator_stack and two operands from operand_stack, applies the operator implementation from self.operators to the operands, pushes the result back onto operand_stack, and returns the updated stacks." apply_operator]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance providing the operators mapping used to resolve operator tokens to callable implementations."
        <REF> operand_stack </REF>: list "Stores the operands used in the operation; mutated by popping two operands and appending the result."
        <REF> operator_stack </REF>: list "Stores the operator tokens; mutated by popping the current operator from the top."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: tuple "A tuple containing the mutated operand_stack and operator_stack after the operator has been applied."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Pop the top item from operator_stack and bind it to operator; operator_stack is mutated by removing that item. This step requires operator_stack to be non-empty. RESULT operator]
            [COMMAND Within the if/else construct on operator == '^', whose branches are identical, pop the top item from operand_stack and bind it to operand2. This step requires operand_stack to be non-empty. RESULT operand2]
            [COMMAND Within the same if/else construct and shared branch body, pop the next top item from operand_stack and bind it to operand1. This step requires operand_stack to have at least two items at this point. RESULT operand1]
            [COMMAND Within the same shared branch body, look up the callable associated with operator in self.operators, call it with (operand1, operand2), and bind the returned value to result. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Within the same shared branch body, push result onto operand_stack. RESULT operand_stack]
            [COMMAND Return the tuple (operand_stack, operator_stack) after the branch body completes. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
